tasks.label: Datapacks: build all conformance cases
tasks.detail: Compile every conformance/cases/*/input.json to target/datapacks/<case>.zip. Copy those into a world's datapacks/ folder to test in game. Failure cases (no expected/ tree) are expected to error and are skipped.
tasks.command: $out = 'target/datapacks'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $out | Out-Null; Get-ChildItem conformance/cases -Directory | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "--- $($_.Name)"; cargo run -q -p packsmith-cli -- build "$($_.FullName)/input.json" --target 26.2 --output "$out/$($_.Name).zip" }

tasks.label: Datapacks: build case of open input.json
tasks.detail: Compile the input.json in the folder of the currently open file to target/datapacks/<case>.zip. Open any conformance case's input.json first.

tasks.label: Conformance: xtask ci
tasks.detail: fmt check + clippy + tests + conformance suite (structure, build, byte-for-byte reproducibility). Run before calling a change done.

linux.command: git fetch --prune && git fetch -p ; git branch -r | awk '{print $1}' | egrep -v -f /dev/fd/0 <(git branch -vv | grep origin) | awk '{print $1}' | xargs --no-run-if-empty git branch -D

windows.command: git fetch --prune; git branch -vv | Select-String origin | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString().Trim() -replace '\*', '' } | Where-Object { $_ -match '^\s*(\S+)\s+\w+\s+\[origin/([^\]:]+).*: gone\]' } | ForEach-Object { ($_ -split '\s+')[0] } | ForEach-Object { git branch -D $_ }
